title: Random Dynamics of a Family of Cubic Polynomials
summary: In this work, we study the non-autonomous dynamics generated by random iterations of the cubic family of the form $z^3 + cz$. The parameter sequence is chosen randomly from a bounded Borel subset of $\mathbb{C}$. We investigate topological properties of the corresponding Julia sets, with particular emphasis on conditions leading to total disconnectedness. We prove that the set of parameter sequences for which the Julia set is totally disconnected is dense in the parameter space.
